parts.text: Please write a story for my 6-year-old child. They have mastered short_vowels and they are working on digraphs. They love cats. Their sight words are: the, said, is, to, a.
My 7-year-old is learning blends. She has already mastered short vowels and digraphs. Her interest is dinosaurs. Sight words: was, they, of, the.
I need a story for my 8-year-old. He is working on silent_e and has mastered short_vowels, digraphs, and blends. He is interested in space. Sight words: are, have, your, there.
My 9-year-old child wants a story about robots. Her reading target level is r_controlled. Mastered levels are: short_vowels, digraphs, blends, silent_e. Sight words: some, come, here.

I want a story for an 11-year-old child. Their target level is vowel_teams. They have mastered short_vowels, digraphs, blends, silent_e, and r_controlled. They love deep sea exploration. Sight words: once, one, give, live, they.
A story for my 12-year-old child who is working on blends. They mastered short vowels and digraphs. Their interest is soccer. Sight words: of, to, the, was.
My 5-year-old only knows short_vowels. He likes dogs. Sight words: a, i, the, is.
